svg.aria-label: Ten projects by Lautaro Chini Peyran

g.text: 01 / AQUADELLE
Industrial water-purification platform built at Dellepere Enterprises, pairing a web control layer with plant machinery.
Tracks treatment runs and sensor data on PostgreSQL, with a Next.js operator interface for day-to-day monitoring.
TYPESCRIPT · NEXT.JS · POSTGRESQL · DELLEPERE ENTERPRISES
02 / FLETEYA
Freight and logistics platform connecting customers with carriers across Uruguay, in active development since January 2026.
Handles quoting, booking and trip tracking on a PostgreSQL core behind a Next.js front end.
NEXT.JS · TYPESCRIPT · POSTGRESQL · LOGISTICS · ACTIVE
03 / PROSPECTMCP
MCP server and REST API that prospects businesses from Google Maps, filtering by whether they already have a website.
Pulls reviews, detects social profiles, and generates Claude Code prompts for building each business a landing page.
TYPESCRIPT · MCP · GOOGLE PLACES API · SERPAPI · NODE.JS
04 / DOSDOS
Mobile dating app built around the Uruguayan “2x2” format: friends match as duos rather than as individuals.
Both members of each pair must swipe right before a match opens a realtime group chat for all four.
REACT NATIVE · EXPO · TYPESCRIPT · SUPABASE · PRISMA · REALTIME
05 / SMARTEMAIL.AI
AI email assistant that drafts, rewrites and summarises correspondence through the Gemini API.
Built on Firebase for auth and storage, with a Next.js interface designed around fast keyboard use.
NEXT.JS · TYPESCRIPT · GEMINI API · FIREBASE · AI
06 / JARVIS WEATHER HUD
Weather client rendered as an Iron Man-style terminal HUD, with a 3D holographic globe at the centre of the screen.
Roughly 9,000 points draw the continents in three.js; searched cities get a pulsing marker and per-condition animations.
TYPESCRIPT · THREE.JS · REACT THREE FIBER · OPENWEATHER API
07 / SPOTIFY CLI
Command-line Spotify client with playback control, search, playlists and Spotify Connect device switching.
Fully keyboard-driven, rendered with Ink and styled after the Claude Code terminal aesthetic.
TYPESCRIPT · NODE.JS · INK · SPOTIFY API · CLI
08 / MARKETPLACE SCRAPER API
HTTP API that extracts Facebook Marketplace listings with headless Chromium, filtering by query, location and price.
Ships with a TypeScript MCP server so the same data is available as a tool inside Claude Desktop and Claude Code.
JAVASCRIPT · TYPESCRIPT · PLAYWRIGHT · MCP · SCRAPING
09 / BOOKFLOOW
Marketplace for renting, trading and selling second-hand books between readers.
Next.js front end over a catalogue and listing model, built end to end rather than as a demo.
NEXT.JS · JAVASCRIPT · MARKETPLACE
10 / VEHICLE REGISTRY
Desktop vehicle-registry application written in C#, covering record entry, lookup and administration.
Built to practise typed domain modelling and persistence outside the JavaScript ecosystem.
C# · .NET · DESKTOP
